name: Obel Mono (monospace font with API-key masking build)
summary: Free monospace typeface from Typographic Systems, weights 100-900 roman + italic, variable and static. Ships a second build, Obel Mono Masked, whose glyph substitutions visually hide API keys and secrets (205 key prefixes from 82 issuers) behind dots in terminals and screen shares; copying still yields the real text.

access.notes: SIL OFL 1.1: free personal/commercial use; cannot sell the font by itself; derivatives stay OFL. Masking is visual only, not a security control.

procedure: Download ObelMono-1.001.zip (all formats) or the -ttf / -woff2 / Masked zips
Install the TTF/OTF, or self-host the WOFF2 on the web

stats.count: 2 families (Obel Mono, Obel Mono Masked), weights 100-900 + italics

verdict.why: Original, genuinely useful twist (secret masking for streams/screenshares) on a full-featured OFL coding font; strong reception (2k likes); direct download, no signup. First fonts entry in the catalog.
